tasks.subject: Task 1: `make release` and version stamping
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `make release VERSION=x.y.z` produces static, version-stamped `otter-node` for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64,

```json:metadata
{"files": ["otter-server/.gitignore", "otter-server/Makefile", "otter-server/cmd/otter-admin/main.go", "otter-server/cmd/otter-admin/main_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "`cd otter-server && make release VERSION=0.0.1-test && dist/otter-node_0.0.1-test_linux_amd64 version && (cd dist && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS)`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`make release` without `VERSION` fails with \"set VERSION=x.y.z\".", "`make release VERSION=0.0.1-test` creates `dist/otter-node_0.0.1-test_linux_{amd64,arm64}`, `dist/otter-admin_0.0.1-test_<goos>_<goarch>`, `dist/SHA256SUMS`; `file` reports \"statically linked\".", "`dist/otter-node_0.0.1-test_linux_amd64 version` prints `0.0.1-test`; `otter-admin version` prints the version.", "Older versions in `dist/` are kept; `SHA256SUMS` covers every `otter-*_*` file."]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: `otter-node probe`, `check`, `backup`
tasks.description:
**Goal:** three operator subcommands the scripts rely on: a pinned-TLS hello probe, a pre-start config check, and a

```json:metadata
{"files": ["otter-server/cmd/otter-node/main.go", "otter-server/internal/client/client.go", "otter-server/internal/nodecheck/check.go", "otter-server/internal/probe/probe.go", "otter-server/internal/store/backup.go"], "verifyCommand": "`cd otter-server && go test -race ./internal/probe ./internal/nodecheck ./internal/store ./internal/client ./cmd/otter-node`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`otter-node probe --url wss://H:P/path --pin B64 [--pin …] [--addr IP:PORT] [--insecure] [--expect-node HEX] [--timeout 10s]` prints `ok node_id=<hex> protocol=1 rtt=<n>ms` and exits 0; exits 1 on wrong pin, wrong node id, timeout, or a `wss` URL without `--pin`/`--insecure`. It needs no config file.", "`--addr` dials that address but keeps the URL host for SNI and certificate checks.", "`otter-node check --config F` verifies: config loads; node key reads; `manifest_file` verifies against `network_pub`; this node is in the manifest; the manifest endpoint path equals `wss.path`; `tls_cert`/`tls_key` load as a pair and the certificate's pin is in the endpoint's pins. Prints one `ok …` line per check, or the first failure, and never opens the database.", "`otter-node backup --config F --out FILE` writes a consistent copy (`VACUUM INTO`) while the node may be running; refuses an existing `FILE`."]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: `otter-admin` DNS and node operations
tasks.description:
**Goal:** the admin commands from docs/11 §5–§6: `dns records`, `dns check`, `node set-ip`, `node rotate-tls`,

```json:metadata
{"files": ["otter-server/cmd/otter-admin/main.go", "otter-server/internal/admin/nodeops.go", "otter-server/internal/admin/tls.go", "otter-server/internal/pinning/pinning.go"], "verifyCommand": "`cd otter-server && go test -race ./internal/admin ./internal/pinning ./cmd/otter-admin`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`dns records` prints, per node with a hostname (not an IP literal), one `A`/`AAAA` line per IP from `nodes/<label>/meta.json`, TTL 300, under a comment header; nodes without IPs get `; <label>: no IPs recorded (node set-ip)`.", "`dns check [--label L]` resolves each hostname and prints `ok`, `MISSING <ip>`, `UNEXPECTED <ip>` per node; exit 1 on any mismatch or resolution error; IP-literal hosts print `skip (IP endpoint)`.", "`node set-ip --label L --ip A [--ip B]` rewrites `meta.json`, re-issues `tls.crt` (and `tls.new.crt` if staged) with the **same key** and new SANs; the pin is unchanged; prints the DNS records to update. The manifest is not changed.", "`node rotate-tls --label L` writes `tls.new.{crt,key}` and appends the new pin (refuses if already staged); `node drop-old-pins --label L` moves `tls.*` → `tls.old.*`, `tls.new.*` → `tls.*`, keeps only the new pin (refuses if nothing is staged). Both say \"Run 'manifest sign' and 'manifest publish'\".", "`node env --label L` prints shell-quoted `OTTER_LABEL OTTER_HOST OTTER_PORT OTTER_PATH OTTER_NETWORK_PUB OTTER_NODE_ID OTTER_NODE_DIR OTTER_TLS_CERT OTTER_TLS_KEY OTTER_PIN OTTER_KIND` (TLS = the staged pair when present; `OTTER_PIN` = pin of that certificate, base64; `OTTER_KIND` = `wss`|`plain`)."]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Server — profile updates (`directory.update`, `registered_ms`)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** a logged-in member can publish a newer version of their own directory entry; username clash ranking stays

```json:metadata
{"files": ["otter-server/proto/otter/v1/records.proto"], "verifyCommand": "`cd otter-server && make gen && go test -race ./internal/records ./internal/store ./internal/service ./internal/gateway`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`DirectoryEntry.registered_ms` (field 9, `int64`); a record with `registered_ms > created_ms + 5 min` is `INVALID`.", "`users.entry_created_ms` = `registered_ms` when > 0, else the record's `created_ms`; a replicated clash between a v2 entry (registered earlier) and another user's v1 entry keeps the name with the earlier registration.", "`directory.update{record}`: OK for a newer version of the caller's own entry with the same username and account key; `UNAUTHORIZED` for someone else's entry; `INVALID` for a changed username or non-directory record; `CONFLICT` for a version ≤ the current; `RETRY_LATER` when the node doesn't know the user yet. Every other connected client gets a `directory` event; `directory.sync` returns the new display name.", "Peers replicate the update like any directory entry (existing replication; covered by the meshsim run in `make check`)."]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Bundle — templates, `make-bundle.sh`, server-side scripts
Task 6: `push.sh`, `upgrade.sh`, `check.sh`
tasks.description:
**Goal:** the admin-side scripts that install a bundle remotely, upgrade with automatic rollback, and run the docs/11 §7

```json:metadata
{"files": ["otter-server/deploy/push.sh"], "verifyCommand": "`bash -n deploy/push.sh deploy/upgrade.sh deploy/check.sh` (behaviour is verified by the VM test, Task 7)", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`push.sh <label> <root@host>`: builds the bundle if missing, uploads it to a `mktemp -d` dir, runs `install.sh`, removes the remote copy, runs `check.sh <label> <target>`, then deletes the local bundle and moves the included invites to `$OTTER_ADMIN_DIR/invites/delivered/`. A failure keeps the local bundle and exits non-zero.", "`upgrade.sh <root@host> <binary>`: verifies the checksum on the server, backs up the DB with the **installed** binary, swaps binaries (keeps `.prev`), restarts, runs `health.sh`. On failure: restores `.prev` and the DB copy, restarts, keeps the bad binary as `otter-node.failed`; exit 0 = upgraded, 2 = rolled back, 3 = rollback failed.", "`check.sh <label> [root@host]`: `dns check` (skipped when `OTTER_SKIP_DNS=1` or the host is an IP), probe with the pin (must pass), probe with a random pin (must fail), decoy `GET /` = 200 via `curl -k`; with a target also `systemctl is-active`, `NTPSynchronized=yes`, `health.sh`, and no \"not listed in the manifest\" log line since boot. `OTTER_PROBE_ADDR=host:port` overrides where the admin-side probes connect. Prints a PASS/FAIL table; exit 1 on any FAIL."]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: VM end-to-end test (install, check, upgrade, rollback, backup, uninstall)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** a scripted run of the real scripts against a disposable Debian 12 VM under QEMU/KVM, plus the Android live

```json:metadata
{"files": ["otter-server/.gitignore", "otter-server/deploy/test/e2e.sh", "otter-server/deploy/test/vm.sh"], "verifyCommand": "`cd otter-server && deploy/test/e2e.sh` → ends with `e2e: all steps passed`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`deploy/test/vm.sh start|stop|ssh` boots a Debian 12 `genericcloud` amd64 image (downloaded once to `~/.cache/otter-vm/`, verified against Debian's `SHA512SUMS`) as a throwaway overlay, root SSH key login via cloud-init NoCloud (seed served over HTTP on 127.0.0.1:8099), forwards `127.0.0.1:2222→22` and `127.0.0.1:27443→27443`.", "`deploy/test/e2e.sh` (exit 0 only if every step passed): network with node `vm` (`--wss-host 127.0.0.1`), bootstrap invite, `push.sh` → install + checks pass; `push.sh` again (idempotent) passes; `upgrade.sh` to `0.0.2-e2e` → exit 0 and the node reports `0.0.2-e2e`; `upgrade.sh` with a broken binary → exit 2, node still answers and reports `0.0.2-e2e`; `backup.sh --install` + `systemctl start otter-backup.service` → one `node-*.db` in `/var/backups/otter`; `uninstall.sh` keeps `/var/lib/otter`; `uninstall.sh --purge` removes it.", "With `--keep`, e2e stops before uninstall and prints the bootstrap link; then `LiveNodeTest` passes against the VM over pinned TLS (`OTTER_DEV_INVITE=<link>`). Record the run in the M1.5 notes (Task 12)."]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 11: First real deployment (with the owner)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** the milestone's "done when": a node installed on a real VPS from a bundle, the app connected over pinned TLS,

```json:metadata
{"files": ["docs/09-roadmap.md", "otter-android/docs/m1.5-manual-test.md"], "verifyCommand": "`deploy/check.sh <label> root@<server-ip>` → `all checks passed`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["The owner provides: the server (Hetzner, Linode or bare metal; Debian 12/13 or Ubuntu 22.04/24.04, root SSH key login), the domain, and whether it's a **new** network (then `network init` + bootstrap invite) or an extra node for an existing dev network. **Ask before touching any real server or DNS**; never put the admin key on a server.", "Following docs/11 §5 literally: `make release`, `node add`, `manifest sign`, `dns records` → owner creates the records → `dns check` ok → `make-bundle.sh`/`push.sh` → `check.sh <label> root@<ip>` all PASS.", "Both phones join (bootstrap link → second member by in-app invite), exchange messages, rename works.", "`upgrade.sh` to a new version succeeds; a deliberately broken binary rolls back (exit 2) without losing the chat.", "Every place where docs/11 didn't match reality is fixed in docs/11 (Task 12) and listed in the M1.5 notes."]}
```
